name: pup
desc: chibi blue-grey and white puppy pet with big teal eyes, fluffy fur and a pale scarf tied with a ribbon
details: fine fur strands and soft fluffy tufts, clear glossy eye highlights, neat fabric folds and ribbon edges on the scarf, clean pink paw pads

name: acorn
desc: chibi hedgehog explorer pet with spiky brown quills, brass goggles on its head, a leather satchel with a compass, hugging a big acorn
details: individual quill strands, shiny brass goggles with glass highlights, leather grain with stitching and buckles, wood texture on the acorn, soft cream fur

name: shark
desc: chibi blue shark pet in a white captain's hat with a gold anchor badge, holding a magnifying glass, with a small lantern
details: smooth shark skin with a soft sheen, crisp gold trim and anchor badge, clean glass lens highlight, neat white teeth, small fabric folds and seams
note: The red-and-white life ring and the small lantern are separate things: keep each one as it is.

name: starbear
desc: chibi cream bear pet with curled ram horns, a navy wizard hat with little stars, a cape with gold patterns, hugging a yellow star plush
details: soft fur texture, crisp stitching on the star plush, fine gold embroidery patterns, fabric folds on hat and cape, smooth horn ridges, clear eye highlights

name: shadecat
desc: chibi dark purple and black cat pet with magenta accents, red eyes, spiky fur tufts and little crystal charms
details: fine fur strands, glowing magenta edge highlights, crisp crystal facets, clear glossy eye highlights, clean pink paw pads

name: fox
desc: chibi white fox pet with fiery orange-red ears and tails, flame wisps, and a red scarf with a golden bell
details: soft fur strands, smooth flame gradients from yellow to red, shiny golden bell, fabric folds on the scarf, clear glossy eye highlights
note: The back of the head and body keep the same soft peach-orange colour as in the input; the red scarf and golden bell are only under the chin at the front and never appear on the back.

name: granny
desc: chibi old woman villager with grey hair in a bun, small glasses, a cream dress and a red apron, brown shoes
details: fine hair strands, fabric weave and soft folds, a neat embroidered apron hem, clear friendly face features, leather shoes

name: ali
desc: chibi young man villager with a brown cap, brown hair, an olive vest over a white shirt, green trousers and brown boots
details: fabric weave and stitching, leather texture on boots and belt, fine hair strands, clear face features, small buttons and seams

name: lumi
desc: chibi girl villager with purple hair, a navy blue dress with white frills, glasses, a small satchel and brown boots
details: fine hair strands, fabric folds and lace trims, leather boots and satchel, clear face features, small buttons
note: The back of her cape is plain: no bag and no strap are painted on it.

name: C01_bld_cottage
desc: stylized fairy-tale log cottage with a red scalloped tile roof and a small plant
details: wood grain, bark and ring detail on the logs, crisp roof tile edges with subtle chips and colour variation, small moss accents, clean door and window frames

name: C02_bld_shop_granny
desc: stylized village shop with a red scalloped tile roof, a pink fabric awning, wooden posts and a crate of vegetables
details: wood grain on beams and posts, fabric weave and folds on the awning, crisp tile edges with colour variation, fresh vegetable details

name: C03_bld_workshop
desc: stylized small wooden workshop with a red scalloped tile roof, green ivy, a chimney and a round-topped window
details: wooden planks with grain and nail heads, crisp tile edges with colour variation, leafy ivy, warm glass highlight in the window, stone texture on the base

name: C04_bld_lab
desc: stylized round observatory lab with a blue dome, cream plaster walls, climbing ivy, a wooden signboard, a small brass telescope and a brass ring ornament on top
details: soft plaster texture with small cracks, metal bands and rivets on the dome, crisp ivy leaves, polished brass shine, wooden window frames
note: Ivy grows only where the input already shows ivy; do not add more leaves or vines.
